section: Accidental Deaths and Suicides in India 1967
title: presents percentage distribution of accidental deaths by sex in the major States, Union Territories and Cities. On an average about two-thirds of persons (62.4%) who were involved in accidental deaths were males. A similar pattern emerged in almost all the major States, excepting J&K and Assam, where the percentages of males involved were 70.6% and 75.4% respectively. Among the Union Territories also, the overall percentage (76.9%) of males involved is higher than the all-India average. Among the comparable cities, Bombay, Calcutta, Kanpur and Delhi indicated more than 70% of male involvement. TABLE-5 Distribution of accidental deaths by sex-1967
